body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to two allies within 5 units. Until your next turn, each gains +1 Defense against the first Reaction that targets or interrupts it.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense until its next turn.

rider.title: SIGNAL — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an ally within 5 units uses a Reaction: 1–3 gain +1 Defense; 4–5 roll +1 die; 6+ roll +1 die and may move 1 unit after resolving.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
